##### Project general facts

Fortune Bay Residences on Al Marjan Island offers a refined coastal lifestyle with a strong connection to heritage and nature. Developed by Topero Properties, this luxury building draws inspiration from ancient forts, the majestic Hajar Mountains, and traditional Emirati handweaving, weaving cultural authenticity into every element. Featuring a thoughtfully curated collection of one, two, and three-bedroom apartments, each unit is designed with attention to detail, comfort, and a coastal ambiance that promotes relaxation and harmony.

Residents enjoy an elevated lifestyle with exceptional amenities that transform everyday living into a luxurious experience. The building houses a luxury spa, a world-class restaurant, and a premium beauty salon. Fitness enthusiasts appreciate a fully equipped gym, Pilates and yoga spaces, an adult swimming pool, and a dedicated children's pool with a play area. Just steps away, the private beach creates the perfect balance between relaxation and an active lifestyle.

Every residence at Fortune Bay Residences celebrates the natural beauty of its surroundings by incorporating eco-friendly materials, regional landscaping, and energy-efficient solutions. Zigzag mountain shapes are integrated into the interiors through wall textures, lighting, and ceiling details, creating harmonious spaces. Apartments are fully furnished with modern finishing and equipped kitchens, offering a seamless blend of tradition, natural landscapes, and contemporary comfort.

##### Location description and benefits

Nestled on Al Marjan Island, a stunning man-made archipelago in Ras Al Khaimah, this exceptional location is one of the region's most prominent tourist destinations. Known for its picturesque beaches, luxurious resorts, and upscale residential developments, the island is shaped like a coral reef with primary islands connected by a central boulevard, offering breathtaking views of the Arabian Gulf.

The location is distinguished by its pristine white sandy beaches and crystal-clear waters, providing an ideal setting for sunbathing, swimming, and water sports. The island boasts a collection of luxurious hotels and resorts with world-class amenities, private beaches, swimming pools, spas, and gourmet dining options. The Wynn Casino is just a short walk away, and Sharjah International Airport is within easy reach, enhancing the area's appeal.

For those seeking a residence that embodies coastal elegance, cultural richness, and refined living, Al Marjan Island delivers an unmatched lifestyle. Its unique combination of natural beauty, world-class amenities, and a prime Ras Al Khaimah location makes it one of the region's most desirable destinations. This is a place where one can enjoy the best of seaside living— serene, sophisticated and effortlessly connected.
